title: Evaluation of Efficacy, Safety, and Tolerability of Povetacicept in Subjects With Primary Membranous Nephropathy
official: A Phase 2b/3 Adaptive, Randomized, Active controlled Study Evaluating the Efficacy, Safety, and Tolerability of Povetacicept Versus Calcineurin Inhibitor in the Treatment of Primary Membranous Nephropathy
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the efficacy of povetacicept in subjects with pMN

interventions.name: ALPN-303 Solution for Injection in Pre-filled Pen

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Diagnosed with pMN with confirmatory historical biopsy. If no historical biopsy was performed that confirmed pMN, a biopsy can be performed during Screening to confirm eligibility.
2. Other protocol defined Inclusion/Exclusion criteria will apply
Exclusion criteria:
1. Hypersensitivity to investigational medicinal product or to any of its excipients.
2. Other protocol defined Inclusion/Exclusion criteria will apply
